info.title: Flowon.Xrm.Tools.CommandLine
info.description: Logic Fabric tools and libraries for Dataverse and Dynamics 365.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Flowon command-line tools for Dataverse (Dynamics 365): export and import Flowon projects, generate documentation and OpenAPI schemas, and manage solutions, plug-ins, recipes and APIs. Run a command with --help for its options.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

commands.name: features
commands.description: List the Flowon features installed in a Dataverse environment, with their versions.

options.name: --connectionstring
options.description: The connection string of the Dataverse (Dynamics 365) environment, for example "AuthType=OAuth;Url=https://contoso.crm.dynamics.com;...".

options.name: --log-level
options.description: How much to log while the command runs: `none` (errors only, the default), `info` (progress) or `verbose` (diagnostic details, including full error details). [default: None]

commands.name: projects
commands.description: List the Flowon projects in a Dataverse environment, with their solutions and publisher prefixes.

options.name: --connectionstring
options.description: The connection string of the Dataverse (Dynamics 365) environment, for example "AuthType=OAuth;Url=https://contoso.crm.dynamics.com;...".

options.name: --log-level
options.description: How much to log while the command runs: `none` (errors only, the default), `info` (progress) or `verbose` (diagnostic details, including full error details). [default: None]

commands.name: export
commands.description: Export a Flowon project as a Flowon package (<project name>.flop), optionally with its Dataverse solution and reference data.

options.name: --connectionstring
options.description: The connection string of the Dataverse (Dynamics 365) environment, for example "AuthType=OAuth;Url=https://contoso.crm.dynamics.com;...".

options.name: --project-name
options.description: The name of the Flowon project to export.

options.name: --solution-managed
options.description: Also export the project's Dataverse solution as a managed solution. [default: False]

options.name: --solution-unmanaged
options.description: Also export the project's Dataverse solution as an unmanaged solution. Not possible when the solution is managed in this environment. [default: False]

options.name: --output-directory
options.description: The folder where the package, solutions and data files are written. It is created if it does not exist; existing files with the same names are replaced.

options.name: --data-spec-file-path
options.description: The path of a data specification file that lists the reference data (records) to export with the project.

options.name: --log-level
options.description: How much to log while the command runs: `none` (errors only, the default), `info` (progress) or `verbose` (diagnostic details, including full error details). [default: None]

commands.name: import
commands.description: Import into a Dataverse environment, in this order: a solution, data files, then a Flowon package with its data map files. Give at least one of them.

options.name: --connectionstring
options.description: The connection string of the Dataverse (Dynamics 365) environment, for example "AuthType=OAuth;Url=https://contoso.crm.dynamics.com;...".

options.name: --package-file-path
options.description: The path of the Flowon package (.flop) to import. The package's Dataverse solution must already be installed, or be given with --solution-file-path.

options.name: --solution-file-path
options.description: The path of a Dataverse solution file (.zip) to import first. A managed solution is skipped when the installed version is the same or newer.

options.name: --override-unmanaged-customizations
options.description: Overwrite unmanaged customizations made on top of the solution's managed components. Without this option they are kept. Only valid with --solution-file-path. [default: False]

options.name: --map-file-path
options.description: The path of a data map file to apply to the package, as produced by `generate-mappings`. Repeat the option, or list several paths, for more than one. Requires --package-file-path.

options.name: --data-file-path
options.description: The path of a data file to import, as produced by `export --data-spec-file-path`. Repeat the option, or list several paths, for more than one.

options.name: --log-level
options.description: How much to log while the command runs: `none` (errors only, the default), `info` (progress) or `verbose` (diagnostic details, including full error details). [default: None]

commands.name: generate-mappings
commands.description: Extract the data map files (the environment-specific configuration values, localized resources, service connections and entity record references) from a Flowon package, so they can be edited per environment before `import` or `apply-mappings`. Does not need a Dataverse connection.

options.name: --project-file-path
options.description: The path of the Flowon package (.flop), as produced by the `export` command.

options.name: --output-directory
options.description: The folder where the data map files are written. It is created if it does not exist; existing files with the same names are overwritten.

options.name: --log-level
options.description: How much to log while the command runs: `none` (errors only, the default), `info` (progress) or `verbose` (diagnostic details, including full error details). [default: None]

commands.name: generate-openapi
commands.description: Generate the OpenAPI schema (JSON) of a published version of a Flowon API.

options.name: --connectionstring
options.description: The connection string of the Dataverse (Dynamics 365) environment, for example "AuthType=OAuth;Url=https://contoso.crm.dynamics.com;...".

options.name: --project-name
options.description: The name of the Flowon project the API belongs to.

options.name: --api
options.description: The name of the Flowon API.

options.name: --version
options.description: The published version of the API, for example 2.1. Defaults to the latest published version.

options.name: --output-directory
options.description: The folder where the schema is written, as <API name>.json. It is created if it does not exist; an existing file with the same name is replaced.

options.name: --log-level
options.description: How much to log while the command runs: `none` (errors only, the default), `info` (progress) or `verbose` (diagnostic details, including full error details). [default: None]

commands.name: enable-plugins
commands.description: Enable the plug-in steps of the Flowon features installed in a Dataverse environment, for example after `disable-plugins`.

options.name: --connectionstring
options.description: The connection string of the Dataverse (Dynamics 365) environment, for example "AuthType=OAuth;Url=https://contoso.crm.dynamics.com;...".

options.name: --log-level
options.description: How much to log while the command runs: `none` (errors only, the default), `info` (progress) or `verbose` (diagnostic details, including full error details). [default: None]

commands.name: disable-plugins
commands.description: Disable the plug-in steps of the Flowon features installed in a Dataverse environment, for example before a bulk data load.

options.name: --connectionstring
options.description: The connection string of the Dataverse (Dynamics 365) environment, for example "AuthType=OAuth;Url=https://contoso.crm.dynamics.com;...".

options.name: --log-level
options.description: How much to log while the command runs: `none` (errors only, the default), `info` (progress) or `verbose` (diagnostic details, including full error details). [default: None]

commands.name: enable-recipe
commands.description: Enable one or more logic recipes of a Flowon project by activating their plug-in steps.

options.name: --connectionstring
options.description: The connection string of the Dataverse (Dynamics 365) environment, for example "AuthType=OAuth;Url=https://contoso.crm.dynamics.com;...".

options.name: --project
options.description: The name of the Flowon project the recipes belong to.

options.name: --recipe
options.description: The name of a recipe to enable. Repeat the option, or list several names, to enable more than one.

options.name: --log-level
options.description: How much to log while the command runs: `none` (errors only, the default), `info` (progress) or `verbose` (diagnostic details, including full error details). [default: None]

commands.name: disable-recipe
commands.description: Disable one or more logic recipes of a Flowon project by deactivating their plug-in steps, so they stop running.

options.name: --connectionstring
options.description: The connection string of the Dataverse (Dynamics 365) environment, for example "AuthType=OAuth;Url=https://contoso.crm.dynamics.com;...".

options.name: --project
options.description: The name of the Flowon project the recipes belong to.

options.name: --recipe
options.description: The name of a recipe to disable. Repeat the option, or list several names, to disable more than one.

options.name: --log-level
options.description: How much to log while the command runs: `none` (errors only, the default), `info` (progress) or `verbose` (diagnostic details, including full error details). [default: None]

commands.name: increment-solution-version
commands.description: Increment one part of the version of a Dataverse solution, for example 1.2.3.4 to 1.3.3.4 for `--version Minor`.

options.name: --connectionstring
options.description: The connection string of the Dataverse (Dynamics 365) environment, for example "AuthType=OAuth;Url=https://contoso.crm.dynamics.com;...".

options.name: --solution
options.description: The unique name (not the display name) of the solution.

options.name: --version
options.description: The part of the version to increment: `Major`, `Minor`, `Build` or `Revision`. The other parts are kept.

options.name: --log-level
options.description: How much to log while the command runs: `none` (errors only, the default), `info` (progress) or `verbose` (diagnostic details, including full error details). [default: None]

commands.name: docs
commands.description: Generate documentation for the flows, blocks, business processes and APIs in a Flowon package, as a zipped static website named <package name>_docs.zip. Does not need a Dataverse connection.

options.name: --package-file-path
options.description: The path of the Flowon package (.flop) to document, as produced by the `export` command.

options.name: --log-level
options.description: How much to log while the command runs: `none` (errors only, the default), `info` (progress) or `verbose` (diagnostic details, including full error details). [default: None]

options.name: --output-directory
options.description: The folder where <package name>_docs.zip is written. It is created if it does not exist; an existing file with the same name is replaced.

commands.name: apply-mappings
commands.description: Apply data map files to a Flowon project that is already imported, setting its configuration values, localized resources, service connections and entity record references for this environment.

options.name: --connectionstring
options.description: The connection string of the Dataverse (Dynamics 365) environment, for example "AuthType=OAuth;Url=https://contoso.crm.dynamics.com;...".

options.name: --project-name
options.description: The name of the Flowon project, already imported into the environment, to apply the data map files to.

options.name: --map-file-path
options.description: The path of a data map file, as produced by `generate-mappings`. Repeat the option, or list several paths, to apply more than one.

options.name: --log-level
options.description: How much to log while the command runs: `none` (errors only, the default), `info` (progress) or `verbose` (diagnostic details, including full error details). [default: None]

commands.name: publish-api
commands.description: Publish the draft of a Flowon API as a new major or minor version.

options.name: --connectionstring
options.description: The connection string of the Dataverse (Dynamics 365) environment, for example "AuthType=OAuth;Url=https://contoso.crm.dynamics.com;...".

options.name: --project
options.description: The name of the Flowon project the API belongs to.

options.name: --api
options.description: The name of the Flowon API to publish.

options.name: --version
options.description: Whether to publish the draft as a new `Major` version (the default) or a new `Minor` version. [default: Major]

options.name: --log-level
options.description: How much to log while the command runs: `none` (errors only, the default), `info` (progress) or `verbose` (diagnostic details, including full error details). [default: None]

commands.name: create-patch
commands.description: Create a patch for a Dataverse solution and print the patch's unique name.

options.name: --connectionstring
options.description: The connection string of the Dataverse (Dynamics 365) environment, for example "AuthType=OAuth;Url=https://contoso.crm.dynamics.com;...".

options.name: --solution-name
options.description: The unique name (not the display name) of the solution to patch.

options.name: --patch-name
options.description: The display name of the new patch.

options.name: --version
options.description: The version of the patch, for example 1.0.1.0. It must keep the solution's major and minor parts. Defaults to the next build number after the solution's latest patch.

options.name: --log-level
options.description: How much to log while the command runs: `none` (errors only, the default), `info` (progress) or `verbose` (diagnostic details, including full error details). [default: None]
